subject: Crabs wearing hats
topic: This crab is wearing a sponge on its back, like a hat.
script:
This crab is wearing a sponge on its back, like a hat.
It's a decorator crab.
It uses special back legs to hold the sponge in place.
Scientists think the sponge works as camouflage, so predators don't notice the crab underneath.
This one was carrying a glass sponge, more than seven hundred meters down.
And it's not the only crab that dresses up.
This hermit crab skipped the usual shell, and carries a living anemone instead.
Anemones have stinging tentacles, so they make a pretty good bodyguard.
Which hat would you pick?
